aboutParagraphs: Diavolo at New Hope is the Triangle's championship showpiece — a long, wooded course in Cary that opened in October 2020 and immediately became one of the region's most respected tests. From the red tees it plays 7,184 feet at par 75, with four full layouts stretching past 10,000 feet from the longest pads.

Designed by Jay Pontier and Mike Sink, the course is built around water — two full water holes and three 'fusion' holes (10/11, 13/14, 17/18) that merge two baskets into one shared fairway. It's very cart friendly with restrooms on site.
Bring your longest discs and your discipline. This is the course where the Triangle's best players measure themselves.

signatureHoleDescription: Hole 16 is the longest at Diavolo at 615 feet — a par 5 that threads the wooded heart of the course with water never far away. Three committed shots, no shortcuts, and a finish that rewards everything the round has taught you. It's the hole that made the Triangle's newest big course famous.
localTips: Four layouts from red to pink — red is the standard loop, the longest layout stretches past 10,000 feet. Two water holes and three fusion pairs (10/11, 13/14, 17/18) make course knowledge matter. Very cart friendly with restrooms on site. Verify current pay status before you go.
